title: Hornz's Chocolate Modpack
description: This is a Vanilla + Style Modpack That Enhances the Game With new Mobs, Biomes, Blocks, Structures and Much More!
body:
# Hornz's Chocolate Modpack

Hornz's Chocolate Modpack is a Vanilla+ Minecraft modpack focused on exploration, adventure, and quality-of-life improvements.

Journey through hundreds of beautiful new landscapes with Biomes O' Plenty, discover hidden dungeons packed with loot, and stumble across cozy taverns and structures throughout your world. The pack expands Minecraft's exploration while keeping the core vanilla feel intact.

Alongside new world-generation features, Hornz's Chocolate Modpack includes performance, compatibility, and quality-of-life mods to create a smoother and more enjoyable experience for both singleplayer and multiplayer.

## Features

* 🌲 Massive biome expansion with Biomes O' Plenty
* 🏰 New dungeons filled with treasure and challenges
* 🍺 Taverns and unique structures scattered across the world
* ⚡ Performance and optimization improvements
* 🛠️ Helpful quality-of-life features
* 🤝 Multiplayer-friendly support mods
* 🍫 A true Vanilla+ experience

Perfect for players who want more places to explore, more structures to discover, and a richer Minecraft world without straying too far from the original game.
